resources.name: OpenMX DFT code

access.notes: Includes norm-conserving pseudopotentials and optimized pseudo-atomic basis functions (La8.0-s3p3d3f2, Sr10.0-s3p2d2f2, Cu6.0-s2p2d2, O7.0-s2p2d1).

resources.notes: Open-source; all required basis sets and pseudopotentials are part of the distribution.
